Drinking Contest

The GM starts a contest with two or more participants and sets the Fortitude DC. Each round, every qualified participant presses Ready. Once all qualified participants are ready, the module rolls blind-to-GM Performance and Fortitude checks for every participant at the same time.

Fortitude result

Compare the Fortitude save with the GM’s DC. A critical success reduces the participant’s stage by 1; success leaves the stage unchanged; failure increases it by 1; and critical failure increases it by 2. The module assigns or updates the listed conditions and removes a contestant at Stage 6.

StageNameEffect
1Liquid Courage+1 item bonus to saving throws against fear effects for 10 minutes
2TipsyOff-guard and the Stage 1 bonus for 10 minutes
3SloshedClumsy 1, off-guard, stupefied 2 for 10 minutes
4WobblingClumsy 2 and sickened 2 for 10 minutes
5Blackout BoundClumsy 2, sickened 2, stupefied 2 for 10 minutes
6Passed OutUnconscious for 8 hours; eliminated from the contest

Cheating

When becoming Ready, any participant can elect to cheat. Their Fortitude save is treated as a success. They choose either a blind Performance check or a blind Deception check using Create a Diversion; that result is compared independently with every other contestant’s Perception DC. The GM and each observer receive private notices only if the cheating result fails or critically fails against that observer.

Source acknowledgement. This Drinking Contest is a table rule supplied for PF2e Tavern Games.
